adapter_evidence.product_pages: https://www.deltaww.com/en-US/products/<path> (Next.js). Section content is in the response's server-component payload (self.__next_f.push). 'Product Specifications' is either HTML text (CDUs, Li-ion battery systems: 'Label: value' lines) or an embedded published Google document Delta maintains as the specification table (ORV3 power shelves and PSUs).
adapter_evidence.robots: www.deltaww.com disallows /api/, /_next/, /admin/ and declares /sitemap.xml (products-1.xml lists ~4,000 product URLs). docs.google.com allows /document.
adapter_evidence.google_documents: Only https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/<id>/pub documents named inside a Delta product page's specification section are fetched; they are not reachable any other way.

known_gaps: Specification sections in HTML text are kept as rows split only at the vendor's colon; multi-model lines stay as printed.
Efficiency figures for ORV3 PSUs appear in the introduction prose, not in the specification table; operation rows need review.
map-sync is not enabled; product pages are named by reviewed seeds.
